13:1: Alif Lam Meem Ra. Those are the verses of the Book. And that which has been sent down to you from your Rabb is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
13:2: Allah is the One Who raised the heavens without pillars that you see, then He established Himself over the Arsh, He subjected the sun and the moon, each runs until a determined term. He regulates the affair, He details the verses; so that you may believe with certainty in the meeting with your Rabb.
13:3: And it is He Who spread out the earth and placed therein mountains and rivers. And from every kind of fruit He made therein two pairs. He covers the night over the day. Surely in that are signs for a people who reflect.
13:4: And on the earth are neighboring plots, vineyards, crops, and date palms growing from a single root and from separate roots, all watered with one water. And We make some of them excel others in eating. Surely in that are signs for a people who reflect.
13:5: And if you wonder, astonishing is their saying: 'When we are dust, will we really be in a new creation?' Those are they who disbelieved in their Rabb. And those are they who have shackles on their necks. And those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein.
13:6: They ask you to hasten evil before good. Yet before them exemplary punishments have already passed. Surely your Rabb is the Possessor of forgiveness for the people, despite their wrongdoing. And surely your Rabb is severe in punishment.
13:7: Those who disbelieve say: "If only a sign were sent down to him from his Rabb!" You are only a warner, and for every people there is a guide.
13:8: Allah knows what every female carries, what the wombs fall short of and what they increase, and everything with Him is according to a measure.
13:9: He is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Great, the Most High.
13:10: Equal to Him from among you is he who conceals his speech and he who speaks it openly, and he who hides by night and walks freely by day.
13:11: For him are protectors from before him and from behind him, guarding him by the command of Allah. Surely Allah does not change the condition in a people until they change what is in their own souls. And when Allah wills an evil for a people, there is no turning it back. And for them there is no protector besides Him.
13:12: It is He Who shows you the lightning as fear and hope, and produces the heavy clouds.
13:13: The thunder glorifies Him with praise, and the angels from the fear of Him. And He sends the thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills. Yet they dispute about Allah, while He is severe in punishment.
13:14: The true call is only to Him. And those whom they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with anything, but like one who stretches out his hands to water so that it may reach his mouth, yet it will not reach it. And the supplication of the disbelievers is only in straying.
13:15: And to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly and unwillingly, and their shadows as well in the mornings and the evenings.
13:16: Say: "Who is the Rabb of the heavens and the earth?" Say: "Allah." Say: "Have you taken protectors besides Him who possess neither benefit nor harm for themselves?" Say: "Are the blind and the seeing equal? Or are the darknesses and the light equal?" Or have they attributed partners to Allah who created as He created, so that the creation seemed similar to them? Say: "Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, al-Qahhar."
13:17: He sent down water from the sky, and valleys flowed according to their measure, and the flood carried a swelling foam. And from that which they melt in the fire seeking ornaments or utensils, there is a foam like it. Thus does Allah set forth truth and falsehood as an example. As for the foam, it passes away into nothingness, but as for that which benefits people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allah set forth examples.
13:18: For those who responded to their Rabb is goodness. And those who did not respond to Him, if they had all that is in the earth and the like of it with it, they would offer it as ransom.
13:19: Is he who knows that what has been sent down to you from your Rabb is the truth like him who is blind? Only the people of understanding take heed.
13:20: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allah and do not break the pledge.
13:21: And those who join what Allah has commanded to be joined, fear their Rabb, and dread the evil reckoning.
13:22: And those who were patient, seeking the face of their Rabb, established salah, and secretly and openly spent from what We provided for them.
13:23: Gardens of Adn they will enter, as well as the righteous among their fathers, their spouses, and their offspring. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate.
13:24: Saying: "Peace be upon you because you were patient; how excellent is the end of the home!"
13:25: And those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, sever what Allah has commanded to be joined, and cause corruption on the earth; those, upon them is the curse, and for them is the evil home.
13:26: Allah expands provision for whom He wills and restricts it. And they rejoiced in the worldly life. Yet the worldly life, compared to the Hereafter, is but a fleeting enjoyment.
13:27: Those who disbelieve say: 'If only a sign were sent down to him from his Rabb!' Say: 'Surely Allah lets go astray whom He wills, and guides to Himself whoever turns.'
13:28: Those who believed and whose hearts find peace in the remembrance of Allah. Take note, only in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find peace.
13:29: For those who believe and do righteous deeds is a pleasant life and a good place of return.
13:30: Thus We sent you to a community before which many communities have passed away, so that you may recite to them that which We revealed to you. Yet they disbelieve in ar-Rahman. Say: He is my Rabb, there is no god but Him. In Him I have put my trust, and to Him is my return.
13:31: And if there were a Quran by which the mountains were moved, or the earth were torn apart by it, or the dead were made to speak by it, they still would not believe. Yet all affairs belong to Allah. Have those who believe not known that if Allah had willed, He would have guided all people to the right path? A disaster continues to strike those who disbelieve because of what they did, or descends near their homes, until the promise of Allah comes. Surely Allah does not fail in His promise.
13:32: And surely messengers before you were also mocked, but I granted respite to those who disbelieved, then I seized them. How then was My punishment!
13:33: Is He like the one who stands over what every soul has earned? They set up partners to Allah. Say: 'Name them.' Or are you informing Him of something on the earth that He does not know? Or with the apparent of the word? No, their plotting was made alluring to those who disbelieve, and they were hindered from the way. Whomever Allah leads astray, there is no guide for him anymore.
13:34: For them there is a punishment in the life of this world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly more severe, and there is no protector from Allah for them either.
13:35: The example of the Paradise promised to the possessors of taqwa: Rivers flow from beneath it, its food is continuous, its shade too. This is the outcome of the possessors of taqwa. As for the outcome of the disbelievers, it is the Fire.
13:36: Those to whom We gave the Book rejoice in what was revealed to you. Some among the groups deny a part of it. Say: I have only been commanded to worship Allah and not to associate partners with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return.
13:37: And thus We sent it down as an Arabic judgment. If you follow their whims after knowledge has come to you, there is for you against Allah neither a wali nor a protector.
13:38: And certainly We sent messengers before you as well, and We gave them wives and offspring. No messenger could bring a sign without Allah's permission.
13:39: Allah erases what He wills and establishes, and the Mother of the Book is with Him.
13:40: Whether We show you a part of what We promised them or cause you to die, upon you is only the conveying.
13:41: Did they not see that We come to the earth, diminishing it from its edges? Allah judges, there is none to overturn His judgment, and He is swift in reckoning.
13:42: Those before them also plotted, whereas all plotting belongs to Allah, He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom it is.
13:43: Those who disbelieve say: You are not a messenger. Say: Sufficient as a witness between me and you is Allah and the one with whom is the knowledge of the Book.
